name: Dog Trot
source:
A small visual novel based in Dog Trot, Kentucky. Vin wants to leave for college but the only thing in her way is her history final. Help her study to achieve her dreams.

Or don't... It's whatever.

[From [url=https://pigeoncubed.itch.io/dog-trot]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部以肯塔基州Dog Trot为背景的小型视觉小说。文想要去上大学，但唯一阻碍她的是历史期末考试。帮助她学习，实现她的梦想。

或者不……随便吧。

[来自[url=https://pigeoncubed.itch.io/dog-trot]itch.io[/url]]
